scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 5 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 149). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 5'.

XAT QOG'OZI (rasmli bo'shliqlar):
'6th May ......'
'Dear Nick, Many thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you. I was glad to hear that you are going on holiday to Toronto.'
'Unfortunately I can't join you. I can't afford a holiday this year because I want to save some money. I'm 1) ...... ...... work as ...... ...... [RASM: ofitsiant ichimliklar bilan] in an Italian restaurant instead. I'm also 2) ...... ...... take ...... [RASM: 'L' belgili ko'k mashina] ...... because I'm 3) ...... ...... buy ...... ...... [RASM: erkak mashina yonida, sotuv belgisi] before lessons at university start.'
'I'm 4) ...... ...... study ...... [RASM: doskada matematika o'qituvchisi] too, because I want to do well at university. I'm 5) ...... ...... join ...... ...... [RASM: velotrenajyorda erkak] as well, because I've put on weight and I want to get fit.'
'Well, that's all for now. Enjoy yourself and do send me a postcard from Toronto. Best wishes, Robin'

⚠ Bu 5-unitdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon - 'be going to' bilan rejalar.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and complete Robin's letter to Nick with 'going to' and the right words (Unit 5, Writing Project).
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarab Robinning Nickka xatini 'going to' va to'g'ri so'zlar bilan to'ldiring (5-unit, Yozuv loyihasi).
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

6-may
Aziz Nick,
Xating uchun katta rahmat. Sendan
xabar olish juda yoqimli bo'ldi.
Torontoga ta'tilga ketayotganingni
eshitib xursand bo'ldim.

Afsuski, senga qo'shila olmayman.
Bu yil ta'tilga pulim yetmaydi,
chunki pul jamg'armoqchiman. Buning
o'rniga italyan restoranida
OFITSIANT BO'LIB IShLAMOQChIMAN.
HAYDASh DARSLARINI ham OLMOQChIMAN,
chunki universitetda darslar
boshlanishidan oldin MAShINA SOTIB
OLMOQChIMAN.

MATEMATIKANI ham O'RGANMOQChIMAN,
chunki universitetda yaxshi o'qishni
xohlayman. SPORT ZALIGA ham
QO'ShILMOQChIMAN, chunki vazn
qo'shdim va formaga kirmoqchiman.

Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Maza qil va
Torontodan otkritka yubor.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Robin


JAVOBLAR:
  1 going to work as a waiter
  2 going to take driving lessons
  3 going to buy a car
  4 going to study maths
  5 going to join a gym

  ⚠ Hammasi "I'm GOING TO" -
  rejalar (5-unit grammatikasi).


⚠ 'MANY THANKS FOR':

  = ... uchun katta rahmat.


⚠ 'TO HEAR FROM':

  = ...dan xabar olmoq.


⚠ 'UNFORTUNATELY':

  = afsuski.


⚠ "CAN'T AFFORD":

  = pulim yetmaydi.


⚠ 'INSTEAD':

  = o'rniga.


⚠ 'TO PUT ON WEIGHT':

  = vazn qo'shmoq, semirmoq.


⚠ 'TO GET FIT':

  = formaga kirmoq.


⚠ 'DO SEND ME':

  = albatta yubor ('do' -
  kuchaytiruvchi).

items.textEn: I'm 1) ___ work as ___ [picture: man carrying drinks on a tray] in an Italian restaurant instead.
items.answer: going to work as a waiter
items.whyUz: ⚠ "I'm GOING TO work as A WAITER" - reja.

items.textEn: I'm also 2) ___ take ___ [picture: car with 'L' sign]
because I'm 3) ___ buy ___ [picture: man next to a car for sale] before lessons at university start.
I'm 4) ___ study ___ [picture: teacher at blackboard with formulas] too, because I want to do well at university.
I'm 5) ___ join ___ [picture: man on exercise bike] as well, because I've put on weight and I want to get fit.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a similar letter to a friend about your plans for the summer, using 'going to'.
exercises.instructionUz: Do'stingizga yozgi rejalaringiz haqida 'going to' bilan shunga o'xshash xat yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROBIN XATINING TUZILIShI:
  1 Rahmat + do'st yangiligiga
    munosabat
  2 Nega qo'shila olmaysiz + rejalar
    (going to) + sabablar (because)
  3 Yana rejalar
  4 Xayrlashish

  ⚠ 'I'm going to ... because I
  want to ...'

modelAnswers:
Dear Jasur,

Many thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you. I was glad to hear that you are going to visit Samarkand in July.

Unfortunately I can't join you. I'm going to work in my uncle's shop this summer because I want to save some money for a new laptop. I'm also going to take English lessons because I want to pass my exam in September.

I'm going to play football every evening as well, because I want to get fit.

Well, that's all for now. Enjoy yourself and do send me some photos.
Best wishes,
Aziz
modelAnswersUz:
Aziz Jasur,

Har kuni kechqurun futbol ham o'ynamoqchiman, chunki formaga kirmoqchiman.

Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Maza qil va albatta suratlar yubor.

Aziz
